messages.text: Turn on the kitchen lights and tell me my next meeting.
Kitchen lights are on at 80%. Your next meeting is the Design review at 10:30 AM in Studio 3.

quotes.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
quotes.author: Seneca

entries.text: Slow morning. Ran the river loop before the city woke up and felt clear for the first time this week. Remember: the hard part is starting.
Long planning session for the studio move. Too many small decisions; wrote them down so they stop circling.
Dinner with Maya. We talked about the year ahead and what to say no to. Felt lighter walking home.
Read on the porch for an hour. Thoreau on simplicity hit differently today.
